verdict.rationale: Scoped API credentials are a fair question for an email service with a programmatic API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only Graph mail operations, change notifications and send-on-behalf delegation between users. Nothing in it describes issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials (OAuth permission scopes, restricted tokens or app registrations) for an agent, and user-to-user delegation is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
